scope: Test-only meridional section of a parallel beam entering the curved face of a hemisphere. Observe sampled positions on the actual flat Glass face. The table material, continuous spot radius and 3D illumination are outside the study.
assumptions: Rotate the meridional section to put the flat face at x=0. Choose R=100 mm as the scale. Beam travels left from x=200 mm. Exterior index 1, glass index 1.5, transmitted-only approximation, brightness 0.08. No detector or table at the boundary.
predictions: Every observed emitted ray has one curved entry and one flat exit, in that order, without branch creation or absorption. Missing or ambiguous callbacks fail qualification.
Signed flat-face hit ordinates agree within 0.00001 mm with independent Snell propagation from each observed launch ordinate. Both centred samples have symmetric extrema within the incident beam.
Finer midpoint sampling reaches farther from the axis. The displaced narrow control has only positive flat-face hits. A stopped run does not qualify.
